solution.name: Markstrata - Markdown for SharePoint and Teams

shortDescription.default: Markdown from your document libraries, on SharePoint pages and as a Teams tab, themed like GitHub, Obsidian or VS Code.

longDescription.default:
Renders markdown files from a SharePoint document library, from a URL, or typed straight into the web part. A Teams channel’s Files are a document library, so the same web part shows the same documents as a tab.

Themes are modelled on GitHub, Obsidian and VS Code, in light and dark, and are data rather than code: typography, code block contrast, callout shape and syntax colours all follow the editor the documentation was written in.

Documents link to each other. A wiki link, an ordinary relative link, or an address on the page all open the next document in place, with a trail back through the ones before it and a button that copies a link to whichever is on screen. Word, Excel and PowerPoint files embed as a card with SharePoint’s own preview inside it.

Also renders GitHub alerts and Obsidian callouts, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX maths, sortable tables, footnotes, task lists, and code blocks that can show a file from a URL, cap their own height, or open full size.
